records.title: Learner portal access unresolved before partner renewal
records.description: Fictional school partner A reports that accepted learners cannot reach their internship onboarding packs after a portal update. The next cohort kickoff is November second. The coordinator requested a named recovery owner and a verified access test before the partner review. Operations reported a possible recovery in NOTE-001, while the learner-role test in NOTE-002 still fails. The incident may affect the programme agreement renewal in CON-001; no cancellation or contractual restoration condition is confirmed.

records.title: School programme agreement needs a renewal decision
records.description: This invented signed delivery agreement for the current school programme has a recorded face value of INR 180,000. The next-term renewal decision is due November second. The coordinator wants a service recovery update for that discussion. This is an existing programme agreement, not a student tuition bill or a donation pledge. The figure is fictional contractual exposure, not expected loss, cash received or recognized revenue. A renewal has not been signed.

records.title: Internship host cannot access mentor matching invitations
records.description: A fictional corporate host cannot open the mentor matching invitations for its virtual internship projects. The programme coordinator needs confirmed host contacts before onboarding. Confirm the permissions issue, resend a verified invitation and record the next check-in. This is a different access issue from the learner portal incident.

records.title: Corporate internship sponsorship delivery agreement
records.description: This fictional signed sponsorship and delivery agreement funds an internship programme and has a face value of INR 120,000. A partner review is due November sixth. Activities, mentor support and outcome reporting are delivery commitments in this synthetic agreement. Do not treat the amount as a received donation, recognized revenue or a new sales prospect. No change to the signed agreement has been confirmed.

records.title: Corporate host may pause the next placement intake
records.description: The fictional host says it may pause its next intake unless project scope and mentor expectations are clarified. The current sponsored programme is still active. Arrange a partner review, verify the outstanding project briefs with Operations and distinguish a possible future pause from a confirmed withdrawal. No cancellation decision or refund entitlement is recorded.

records.title: School asks for an attendance discussion; agreement unavailable
records.description: A fictional pilot school is concerned about engagement and asks whether a later cohort is appropriate. A short feedback note exists, but no authoritative agreement or financial value is in this dataset. Arrange a coordinator discussion and retrieve the missing commercial context. Do not infer a cancellation, financial loss or actual student circumstances from this incomplete evidence.

records.title: Corporate CSR programme proposal awaits founder follow-up
records.description: A fictional corporate prospect has requested the final scope, mentor commitment and outcome-reporting plan for a sponsored entrepreneurship programme. The recorded potential proposal value is INR 250,000 and a follow-up is due October thirty-first. Nothing is signed and no funds are committed or received. Confirm the next meeting and proposal owner; do not describe the prospect as booked sponsorship revenue.

records.title: New-school bootcamp proposal needs delivery-date confirmation
records.description: A fictional school is considering a mentored startup bootcamp. The proposal records INR 90,000 as potential programme value, subject to scope and dates. Confirm facilitator availability and the school coordinator before sending a final proposal. There is no signed agreement, donor pledge or received payment.

records.title: Regional workshop interest has no confirmed proposal value
records.description: A fictional community partner has expressed interest in an ideation workshop and asked for an exploratory call. Programme scope, participant capacity, funding source and amount are not confirmed. Record the next discovery step. Keep this opportunity in the count of open proposals but exclude its missing amount from financial totals.

records.title: Certificate preview redesign is a roadmap suggestion
records.description: A coordinator suggested clearer certificate previews and a revised layout for future programme completions. The existing workflow remains usable. There is no committed delivery date, contractual promise, current access blocker or cancellation threat associated with this improvement. Capture the feedback for normal platform triage; do not interrupt urgent cohort readiness work.

records.title: Onboarding checklist automation blocked by roster discrepancies
records.description: The fictional internal checklist automation cannot be released until Operations reconciles the accepted-participant roster with mentor and project allocations. The automation is a convenience for coordinators; it is not proof that every learner is ready. Confirm the source-of-truth roster in OPS-004 before resuming the release, and keep a reviewed manual checklist available.

records.title: Mentor coverage for the next cohort is not confirmed
records.description: The fictional Monday bootcamp needs an approved mentor allocation and backup cover. Some mentor availability confirmations are still outstanding. The founder needs a readiness decision today: assign Operations to verify the schedule and ask the programme lead to approve any reduced-capacity plan. This is a synthetic scheduling issue, not a claim about actual YFS staffing.

records.title: Host project briefs are overdue for approval
records.description: The fictional internship host has not approved its final project briefs. Operations must confirm scope, expected student deliverables and mentor check-in responsibilities before placements are allocated. The missing approval also appears in the partner concern CAN-001. Avoid claiming the host has withdrawn until a decision is recorded.

records.title: School onboarding checklist needs coordinator verification
records.description: The fictional cohort checklist has not been reconciled with the school coordinator. Verify aggregate acceptance, parent/guardian permission status where applicable, access readiness and the next communication before marking onboarding complete. This is an invented internal readiness checklist, not legal advice or evidence about actual students. No student names, contact details or individual records are included.

records.title: Roster and mentor availability require reconciliation
records.description: The fictional roster export and mentor availability sheet disagree about which placements are ready. Reconcile the aggregate allocation list with the programme lead, identify the authoritative version and record the verified readiness status. This blocks the checklist automation in REL-001. Do not claim all placements are confirmed from a partial roster.

records.source: Synthetic sponsor reporting and finance queue
records.title: Sponsor outcome report is overdue for evidence reconciliation
records.description: The fictional sponsor report draft mixes registrations with completed participation. Finance and Operations need to reconcile the attendance and completion denominator before sharing an impact or invoice-support report. Keep the signed programme value in CON-002 distinct from verified delivery outcomes and payment receipt. The draft is not an audited impact result and no funding loss is confirmed.

records.title: Facilitator invoice awaits delivery-document matching
records.description: Match the fictional facilitator invoice to the approved programme scope and delivery sign-off before approval. This record is a review task, not evidence of an overdue payment or a new contract exposure amount. The founder should assign a Finance owner and request the missing delivery confirmation; no payment is executed by Praxis.

records.title: Coordinator reports possible portal recovery from an admin check
records.description: A fictional coordinator could open the onboarding page with an administrator account and reported a possible recovery. Learner-role access was not verified in that check. This limited report does not close INC-001 or resolve the conflicting platform test in NOTE-002.

records.title: Learner-role test still fails after the claimed recovery
records.description: A fictional platform check still fails when opening the onboarding pack with a learner-role test account. It conflicts with the administrator-only check in NOTE-001. Request a repeatable learner access test and a named recovery owner before marking the incident restored.

records.title: School feedback note has an unverified participation denominator
records.description: This fictional feedback summary contains broad engagement concerns but does not establish how participation was counted. It is context for CAN-002, not a verified outcome report or a confirmed withdrawal. Ask the school coordinator for aggregate attendance definitions and the missing agreement context.

records.title: Mentor newsletter is ready for routine editorial review
records.description: The fictional monthly mentor newsletter draft has its programme announcements and recognition items assembled. It has no urgent launch dependency. Review the copy and links during the regular editorial window; this update should not displace unresolved cohort access and mentor coverage issues.

records.title: School-introduction notes have been logged
records.description: Fictional introductory conversations from a community event are recorded for later qualification. No proposal amount, promised delivery date, confirmed partnership or donation is established. Routine follow-up can wait behind active programme commitments.

records.title: Programme export defect is completed and verified
records.description: The fictional aggregate export defect was fixed and the programme lead verified the output. It is completed and must not be escalated, even though its old severity was critical. This export fix does not prove learner sign-in access in INC-001 has recovered.

records.title: Withdrawn workshop proposal is closed
records.description: The fictional prospective workshop was withdrawn and this opportunity is cancelled. Its historical potential value must not be included in open partnership pipeline or active priorities. No signed agreement or income was recorded.

records.title: School-outreach webinar page needs programme review
records.description: The fictional outreach page needs its dates and learning outcomes checked before publication. The future webinar is not the historical Build For Good final and must not imply a currently available public programme that has not been announced. Assign a programme reviewer and keep ordinary marketing work behind time-sensitive cohort delivery.

records.title: AI mentor-assistance pilot outline remains in discovery
records.description: This fictional internal proposal explores whether AI could help coordinators prepare mentor check-in summaries. It is an unapproved discovery idea with no committed launch date, student deployment or promised public offering. It does not establish the rollout status of any actual Young Founders School programme.

records.title: Virtual demo-day panel needs availability confirmations
records.description: The fictional programme team needs to confirm mentor and host availability for a later virtual presentation panel. Capture the moderator, panel schedule and backup contact before sending a confirmed calendar invitation. No invitation is sent automatically and there is no immediate access incident in this record.

records.title: Board pre-read is ready for agenda-owner review
records.description: The fictional board pre-read has a draft agenda and programme topics ready for review. Keep unverified sponsor outcome numbers out of the final pack until FIN-001 is reconciled. Routine agenda review can proceed without presenting pending figures as audited outcomes.
